## Kind
- [ ] editorial

## Checklist
- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`)
- [ ] `python tools/check.py` and `reuse lint` pass
- [ ] Examples use fictional parties on `.example` domains; no real infrastructure, risk registers, attack paths or personal data

## AI use
Tick the level of AI involvement in this change.
- [ ] Fully AI-generated, not reviewed line by line
- [ ] AI-designed, AI-coded, checked by a human
- [ ] Human-designed, AI-coded
- [ ] Human-designed, human-coded (AI autocompletion and boilerplate only)

This does not block AI contributions; it tells reviewers where to look harder. Commits say the same in an
`Assisted-by:` trailer. Adapted from Warpgate's pull request template (Apache-2.0).
